scope_comparison: Original specifically bottom-up Splay and an absolute competitive factor, with arbitrary initialization additive f(n). Current Chmel et al Theorem1 proves O(loglog n log^2logloglog n) competitiveness, still unbounded with n; an initialization cost independent of sequence cannot absorb that multiplicative loss over arbitrary long sequences. Conditional regular-access proofs and tournament-heap counterexamples have different scope. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
